objectives: 讓化學系的學生了解基本的生物化學知識以及相關領域的科學
content: 本課程分上下兩學期，上學期主要是介紹構成生物分子的化學物質。主要是 胺基酸 蛋白質，醣類 等性質。而這類化學分子參與了生體結構與酵素的組成。所以，上學期的學習重點也會著重於蛋白質結構 與蛋白質活性，蛋白質參與了身體哪些功能上的運作等等。上學期下半主要是講述身體的代謝過程。生命體如何藉由酵素的作用將攝取的醣類有效轉換成生命體運用之能量ATP，這是需要許許多多一連串的化學反應才能達到!
books: “Text Book:Essential Biochemistry, 4th Edition Charlotte W. Pratt, Kathleen CornelyEssential Biochemistry, 4th Edition is comprised of biology, pre-med and allied health topics and presents a broad, but not overwhelming, base of biochemical coverage that focuses on the chemistry behind biology. Futhermore, it relates the chemical concepts that scaffold the biology of biochemistry, providing practical knowledge as well as many problem-solving opportunities to hone skills. Key Concepts and Concept Review features help students to identify and review important takeaways in each section.“
grading_policy: 兩次 期中考 60％ 一次期末40％
